headline: Central Garden & Pet Stock Declines Following Earnings Report
summary: Central Garden & Pet shares traded lower as investors evaluated the company's latest quarterly operating margins and sales performance.
why: Central Garden & Pet is a leading US producer and distributor of branded products for the pet, lawn, and garden supplies industries.
